en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a cargo motor ship named 'BARDALAND' at sea. The vessel, with multiple masts and cargo booms, is viewed from the side. Maritime signal flags fly from a mast, and a small flag at the stern appears to be the Swedish flag. The lower left corner has printed technical details about the ship, and the lower right corner identifies the shipping line and city.
